evals.name: review-code-by-standards-uses-supplied-immutable-range
evals.prompt: Review the supplied complete diff, immutable base/head SHA, commit list, and repository standards for a change that adds a pass-through adapter.
evals.expected_output: A Standards-only evidence report that consumes the supplied range without selecting a comparison point or coordinating reviewers.
expectations: Uses the supplied fixed comparison point and complete diff
Does not infer a baseline or dispatch another reviewer
Returns Standards evidence to the caller

evals.name: standards-axis-uses-codebase-design-vocabulary
evals.prompt: Review the supplied diff and standards context where a new adapter duplicates interface knowledge across callers.
evals.expected_output: The Standards report evaluates depth, interface, seam, adapter, leverage, and locality as judgement calls.
expectations: Does not report the vocabulary as an invented hard repository rule
Keeps contract fidelity out of the Standards report

evals.name: standards-axis-preserves-fowler-and-repository-precedence
evals.prompt: Review the supplied diff and repository conventions where a repository-approved pattern resembles duplicated code.
evals.expected_output: The report applies repository rules first and treats Fowler smells as evidence-backed judgement calls.
expectations: Names applicable Fowler smells with hunk evidence
Distinguishes hard violations from judgement calls

evals.name: review-code-by-standards-can-deepen-on-structural-signals
evals.prompt: Review a supplied full diff where a shared path gains feature-specific flags across modules and a thin wrapper hides a loosely typed boundary.
evals.expected_output: The reviewer may use strict maintainability heuristics to describe the added complexity, maintenance risk, and a viable simplifying direction.
expectations: Treats structural signals as non-exhaustive heuristics rather than a fixed gate
Uses diff evidence and maintenance consequences
Does not make elegance or a line threshold an automatic blocker

evals.name: review-code-by-standards-keeps-structural-focus-with-mixed-risk-evidence
evals.prompt: Review a supplied diff with a module-boundary concern that also suggests an authorization failure path.
evals.expected_output: The reviewer returns Standards evidence for the module-boundary concern and describes any additional evidence without changing its structural focus.
expectations: Keeps structural maintainability as the primary focus
Reports concrete evidence rather than suppressing it
Does not turn a mixed-risk observation into an unsupported Standards finding
